     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.CechSectionContractibilitySucc
     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# Contractibility of the concrete section Čech complex
    10	
    11	This file proves the augmentation-degree contracting identity and packages all degreewise
    12	identities into a contracting homotopy.
    13	-/
    14	
    15	universe u
    16	
    17	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
    18	
    19	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    20	
    21	open Scheme.Modules
    22	
    23	variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
    24	
    25	section ContractingHomotopy
    26	
    27	variable (𝒰 : X.OpenCover) [Finite 𝒰.I₀] (F : X.Modules) (V : TopologicalSpace.Opens X)
    28	variable (i_fix : 𝒰.I₀) (hiV : V ≤ coverOpen 𝒰 i_fix)
    29	
    30	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
    31	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
    32	-- The augmentation-node identity expands two dependent product coordinates and their sums.
    33	set_option maxRecDepth 4000 in
    34	/-- **(I1)** The augmentation-node contracting identity:
    35	`𝟙 = π_{i_fix} ≫ ε + d⁰ ≫ h₁` on `Č⁰`. -/
    36	private lemma cechSection_comm_one :
    37	    𝟙 ((cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).X 1) =
    38	      cechSectionHomotopyZero 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV ≫ (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d 0 1 +
    39	        (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d 1 2 ≫ cechSectionHomotopyComp 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV 0 := by
    40	  ext t
    41	  apply (sectionCechProductEquiv (fun a => coverOpen 𝒰 a ⊓ V)
    42	    ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F) 0).injective
    43	  funext σ
    44	  refine Eq.symm ?_
    45	  have hsplit : ConcreteCategory.hom
    46	      (cechSectionHomotopyZero 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV ≫ (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d 0 1 +
    47	        (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d 1 2 ≫ cechSectionHomotopyComp 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV 0) t
    48	      = ConcreteCategory.hom (cechSectionHomotopyZero 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV ≫
    49	          (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d 0 1) t +
    50	        ConcreteCategory.hom ((cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d 1 2 ≫
    51	          cechSectionHomotopyComp 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV 0) t := by
    52	    rw [AddCommGrpCat.hom_add_apply]
    53	  refine Eq.trans (congrArg (fun y => sectionCechProductEquiv (fun a => coverOpen 𝒰 a ⊓ V)
    54	    ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F) 0 y σ) hsplit) ?_
    55	  have hco : ∀ (a b : ToType ((cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).X 1)),
    56	      sectionCechProductEquiv (fun a => coverOpen 𝒰 a ⊓ V)
    57	          ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F) 0 (a + b) σ
    58	        = sectionCechProductEquiv (fun a => coverOpen 𝒰 a ⊓ V)
    59	            ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F) 0 a σ +
    60	          sectionCechProductEquiv (fun a => coverOpen 𝒰 a ⊓ V)
    61	            ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F) 0 b σ := fun a b => by
    62	    rw [sectionCechProductEquiv_apply, sectionCechProductEquiv_apply,
    63	      sectionCechProductEquiv_apply]
    64	    exact map_add _ a b
    65	  refine Eq.trans (hco _ _) ?_
    66	  -- piece 1: `π_{i_fix} ≫ ε` is `depDiff (depHomotopy t̃)` at the bottom level
    67	  have hpiece1 : sectionCechProductEquiv (fun a => coverOpen 𝒰 a ⊓ V)
    68	      ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F) 0
    69	      (ConcreteCategory.hom (cechSectionHomotopyZero 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV ≫
    70	        (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d 0 1) t) σ
    71	      = CombinatorialCech.depDiff (A := cechSectionCoeff 𝒰 F V) (cechSectionCoface 𝒰 F V)
    72	          (CombinatorialCech.depHomotopy i_fix (cechSectionPrepend 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV)
    73	            (fun τ => sectionCechProductEquiv (fun a => coverOpen 𝒰 a ⊓ V)
    74	              ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F) 0 t τ)) σ := by
    75	    refine Eq.trans (sectionCechProductEquiv_apply (fun a => coverOpen 𝒰 a ⊓ V)
    76	      ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F) 0 _ σ) ?_
    77	    refine Eq.trans (ConcreteCategory.comp_apply _ (Pi.π _ σ) _).symm ?_
    78	    refine Eq.trans (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (Category.assoc
    79	      (cechSectionHomotopyZero 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV)
    80	      ((cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d 0 1) (Pi.π _ σ)) t) ?_
    81	    refine Eq.trans (ConcreteCategory.comp_apply _ _ t) ?_
    82	    refine Eq.trans (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (sectionCechAugV_π 𝒰 F V σ)
    83	      (ConcreteCategory.hom (cechSectionHomotopyZero 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV) t)) ?_
    84	    refine Eq.symm ?_
    85	    refine Eq.trans (cechSectionDepDiff_zero 𝒰 F V _ σ) ?_
    86	    have htuple : ∀ ρ : Fin 0 → 𝒰.I₀,
    87	        cechSectionPrepend 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV 0 ρ
    88	          (sectionCechProductEquiv (fun a => coverOpen 𝒰 a ⊓ V)
    89	            ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F) 0 t (Fin.cons i_fix ρ))
    90	        = cechSectionPrepend 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV 0 Fin.elim0
    91	            (sectionCechProductEquiv (fun a => coverOpen 𝒰 a ⊓ V)
    92	              ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F) 0 t
    93	              (Fin.cons i_fix Fin.elim0)) := by
    94	      intro ρ
    95	      have hρ : ρ = Fin.elim0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    96	      subst hρ
    97	      rfl
    98	    refine Eq.trans (DFunLike.congr_arg (cechSectionCoface 𝒰 F V 0 σ 0)
    99	      (htuple (σ ∘ (0 : Fin 1).succAbove))) ?_
   100	    refine DFunLike.congr_arg (cechSectionCoface 𝒰 F V 0 σ 0) ?_
   101	    refine DFunLike.congr_arg (cechSectionPrepend 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV 0 Fin.elim0) ?_
   102	    exact (sectionCechProductEquiv_apply (fun a => coverOpen 𝒰 a ⊓ V)
   103	      ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F) 0 t (Fin.cons i_fix Fin.elim0))
   104	  -- piece 2: `d⁰ ≫ h₁` is `depHomotopy (depDiff t̃)`
   105	  have hpiece2 : sectionCechProductEquiv (fun a => coverOpen 𝒰 a ⊓ V)
   106	      ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F) 0
   107	      (ConcreteCategory.hom ((cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d 1 2 ≫
   108	        cechSectionHomotopyComp 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV 0) t) σ
   109	      = CombinatorialCech.depHomotopy i_fix (cechSectionPrepend 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV)
   110	          (CombinatorialCech.depDiff (A := cechSectionCoeff 𝒰 F V) (cechSectionCoface 𝒰 F V)
   111	            (fun τ => sectionCechProductEquiv (fun a => coverOpen 𝒰 a ⊓ V)
   112	              ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F) 0 t τ)) σ := by
   113	    refine Eq.trans (congrArg (fun y => sectionCechProductEquiv (fun a => coverOpen 𝒰 a ⊓ V)
   114	      ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F) 0 y σ)
   115	      (ConcreteCategory.comp_apply _ _ t)) ?_
   116	    refine Eq.trans (cechSectionHomotopyComp_coord 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV 0 _ σ) ?_
   117	    exact DFunLike.congr_arg (cechSectionPrepend 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV 1 σ)
   118	      (cechSectionD_coord 𝒰 F V 0 t (Fin.cons i_fix σ))
   119	  refine Eq.trans (congrArg₂ (· + ·) hpiece1 hpiece2) ?_
   120	  refine Eq.trans (CombinatorialCech.depHomotopy_spec i_fix (cechSectionCoface 𝒰 F V)
   121	    (cechSectionPrepend 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV)
   122	    (fun {m} σ' y => cechSection_hu 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV σ' y)
   123	    (fun {m} σ' k y => cechSection_hsh 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV σ' k y)
   124	    (fun τ => sectionCechProductEquiv (fun a => coverOpen 𝒰 a ⊓ V)
   125	      ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F) 0 t τ) σ) ?_
   126	  exact congrArg (fun y => sectionCechProductEquiv (fun a => coverOpen 𝒰 a ⊓ V)
   127	    ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F) 0 y σ)
   128	    (ConcreteCategory.id_apply t).symm
   129	
   130	/-- The coinductive step: given the previous homotopy condition, the corrected component
   131	`h_{n+2} ≫ (𝟙 - p₂₁ ≫ d)` satisfies the next one (pure preadditive algebra from `(In)`
   132	and `d ∘ d = 0`). -/
   133	private lemma cechSection_succ_step (n : ℕ)
   134	    {f : (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).X (n + 1) ⟶ (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).X n}
   135	    {g : (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).X (n + 2) ⟶ (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).X (n + 1)}
   136	    (hp : 𝟙 ((cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).X (n + 1)) =
   137	      f ≫ (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d n (n + 1) +
   138	        (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d (n + 1) (n + 2) ≫ g) :
   139	    𝟙 ((cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).X (n + 2)) =
   140	      g ≫ (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d (n + 1) (n + 2) +
   141	        (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d (n + 2) (n + 3) ≫
   142	          (cechSectionHomotopyComp 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV (n + 1) ≫
   143	            (𝟙 ((cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).X (n + 2)) -
   144	              g ≫ (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d (n + 1) (n + 2))) := by
   145	  have hIn := cechSection_comm_succ 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV n
   146	  have hsub : (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d (n + 1) (n + 2) =
   147	      (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d (n + 1) (n + 2) ≫ g ≫
   148	        (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d (n + 1) (n + 2) := by
   149	    have h₀ := congrArg (fun m => m ≫ (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d (n + 1) (n + 2)) hp
   150	    simpa only [Category.id_comp, Preadditive.add_comp, Category.assoc,
   151	      HomologicalComplex.d_comp_d, comp_zero, zero_add] using h₀
   152	  have hd1E : (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d (n + 1) (n + 2) ≫
   153	      (𝟙 ((cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).X (n + 2)) -
   154	        g ≫ (cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d (n + 1) (n + 2)) = 0 := by
   155	    rw [Preadditive.comp_sub, Category.comp_id, sub_eq_zero]
   156	    exact hsub
   157	  have hdb := eq_sub_iff_add_eq.mpr ((add_comm _ _).trans hIn.symm)
   158	  rw [← Category.assoc ((cechSectionAugComplex 𝒰 F V).d (n + 2) (n + 3))
   159	    (cechSectionHomotopyComp 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV (n + 1)) _, hdb, Preadditive.sub_comp,
   160	    Category.id_comp, Category.assoc, hd1E, comp_zero, sub_zero]
   161	  abel
   162	
   163	end ContractingHomotopy
   164	
   165	set_option maxRecDepth 8000 in
   166	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
   167	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
   168	-- Coinductive homotopy packaging has deeply nested dependent degree equalities.
   169	/-- The concrete augmented section Čech complex is contractible after choosing a cover member
   170	that contains `V`. -/
   171	noncomputable def cechSection_contractible (𝒰 : X.OpenCover) [Finite 𝒰.I₀]
   172	    (F : X.Modules) (V : TopologicalSpace.Opens X)
   173	    (i_fix : 𝒰.I₀) (hiV : V ≤ coverOpen 𝒰 i_fix) :
   174	    Homotopy (𝟙 ((sectionCechComplexV 𝒰 F V).augment (sectionCechAugV 𝒰 F V)
   175	      (sectionCechAugV_comp_d 𝒰 F V))) 0 :=
   176	  -- The prepend-`i_fix` contracting homotopy on the augmented concrete section complex,
   177	  -- assembled by `Homotopy.mkCoinductive` from the explicit components (`π_{i_fix}` at the
   178	  -- augmentation node, prepend-`i_fix` in the Čech degrees) and the three contracting
   179	  -- identities (I0)/(I1)/(In) proved above via the dependent combinatorial engine.
   180	  Homotopy.mkCoinductive _
   181	    (cechSectionHomotopyZero 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV)
   182	    ((HomologicalComplex.id_f _ _).trans (cechSection_comm_zero 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV))
   183	    (cechSectionHomotopyComp 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV 0)
   184	    ((HomologicalComplex.id_f _ _).trans (cechSection_comm_one 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV))
   185	    (fun n p =>
   186	      ⟨cechSectionHomotopyComp 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV (n + 1) ≫
   187	          (𝟙 (((sectionCechComplexV 𝒰 F V).augment (sectionCechAugV 𝒰 F V)
   188	              (sectionCechAugV_comp_d 𝒰 F V)).X (n + 2)) -
   189	            p.2.1 ≫ ((sectionCechComplexV 𝒰 F V).augment (sectionCechAugV 𝒰 F V)
   190	              (sectionCechAugV_comp_d 𝒰 F V)).d (n + 1) (n + 2)), by
   191	        have hp := (HomologicalComplex.id_f _ _).symm.trans p.2.2
   192	        exact (HomologicalComplex.id_f _ _).trans
   193	          (cechSection_succ_step 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV n hp)⟩)
   194	
   195	end AlgebraicGeometry

name: task-status
description: What the task status labels mean and how you (the agent) set them — you OWN your task's terminal status via `horizon task set`; the machine only ever leaves it queued/running, so `done` is never inferred from your report or a clean exit.
---

A task is the unit of work a run dispatches. **You own its outcome.** The
orchestrator/scheduler only ever writes `queued` and `running`; it never reads
your report and never marks a task `done`, `blocked`, or `failed` for you. If you
do not record a terminal status, the task simply returns to `queued` for the next
round. Record status through the CLI — invoke it via the `$HORIZON_BIN` env var
(an absolute path); a bare `horizon` may not be on your shell's PATH.

## The labels

- `queued` — runnable. The scheduler picks up only queued tasks. This is where a
  task rests between rounds when work remains. **Set by the machine (and humans);
  you normally don't.**
- `running` — a session is actively driving it right now. **Set by the machine at
  dispatch.** Don't set this yourself — it means "another session is live," and
  the CLI refuses to start a second run of a `running` task.
- `done` — the assigned objective is **FULLY complete**: the Lean is proved and
  builds, the blueprint node(s) are closed, nothing in the objective remains. Not
  "mostly done", not "the hard part is done", not "a clean commit landed". **Only
  you can set this, and only when it is genuinely, completely finished.** A
  reviewer (human or work-reviewer subagent) checks it against the diff and the
  Lean state and will flip a premature `done` back — so a false `done` wastes a
  round, it doesn't save one.
- `blocked` — you cannot make progress: a dependency is missing, a decision is
  needed, or an external constraint stops you. Say why in a comment.
- `failed` — you genuinely could not do the work (not merely "ran out of time" —
  that's just `queued` for next round). Say why in a comment.
- `cancelled` — abandoned by a human. You won't normally set this.

## How to set status

```
"$HORIZON_BIN" task set <task_id> --status done      # objective FULLY complete
"$HORIZON_BIN" task set <task_id> --status blocked   # stuck; explain in a comment
"$HORIZON_BIN" task set <task_id> --status failed    # could not do it; explain
```

Authorship is automatic — the CLI stamps your role (normally `horizon`) from the
run environment; do not pass `--author`. Setting a status appends an auditable
history entry, and if the task has `roadmap_refs` the linked roadmap items are
synced (done→done, blocked/failed→blocked, cancelled→rejected).

Task commands also report advisory queue-health warnings. Review an oversized
open queue for duplicated or roadmap-only objectives, and investigate a task
that has remained `running` past the stale-status window. These warnings never
change status for you; if the state is intentional, it may remain as-is.

## Comment as you work

Leave a short comment whenever you hit a significant step or change the status, so
the ledger tells the story without opening raw logs:

```
"$HORIZON_BIN" task comment <task_id> --body "Closed the base case; representability lemma still open."
```

## The one rule to remember

**If the objective is only partly advanced, set nothing.** The task returns to
`queued` and the next round continues it. Reserve `done` for work that is
completely finished — that is the entire point of the status now living with you
instead of being guessed from your report.
